publishFirst.title: Publish "{title}"?
publishFirst.body: It will be visible on the site to everyone.

publishChanges.title: Publish the changes to "{title}"?
publishChanges.body: This replaces the version on the site now. You can't go back to the previous version.

publish.missingEnglish: {count, plural, one {1 English text is missing: the English site will show that text in Spanish.} other {# English texts are missing: the English site will show those texts in Spanish.}}
publish.success: Published. It's on the site now.
publish.revalidateFailed: Published, but the site hasn't updated yet.

discard.title: Discard unpublished changes?
discard.body: The draft goes back to the published version. This can't be undone.

unpublish.title: Unpublish "{title}"?
unpublish.body: The page will no longer be visible on the site and its links will stop working. Nothing is deleted: you can publish it again at any time.

delete.title: Delete "{title}"?
delete.body: It will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.

inUse.title: Can't be deleted
inUse.body: "{title}" is used in: {list}. Remove it from there first.

unsaved.title: You have unsaved changes
unsaved.body: If you leave now, they will be lost.

conflict.title: This entry changed since you opened it
conflict.body: {name} saved it {when}. If you save your version, their changes will be lost.

slugChange.title: Change the address?
slugChange.body: If you change the address, old links stop working and likes go back to zero.

lossySave.title: Save and simplify formatting?
lossySave.body: One or more rich-text fields contained formatting this editor doesn't support. Saving these changes will remove the unsupported formatting.

locale.caption: Content language
locale.fallbackHint: The English site shows the Spanish text.

fixed.note: Fixed site content: it can be edited, but not created or deleted.
fixed.identifier: Used by the site's code; it can't be changed.
fixed.shellNotice: Editor frame ready: full fields for this type arrive in the next step. You can edit the title/name, save, publish, and preview without touching other fields.

protected.legal: Protected legal text. Any editor can prepare changes and save them as a draft. Only authorised people can publish them.
protected.doctrine: Protected doctrinal content. Any editor can prepare changes and save them as a draft. Only authorised people can publish them.
protected.noPermission: You need the "Publish protected content" permission. Save the draft and ask an authorised person to review and publish it.

trial.banner: Trial mode: what you edit here doesn't show on the site yet and may be erased in the migration.
